info.name: APTECH-4 Local Compose
info.description:
Local production-like stack via Nginx.

**Prerequisites**
1. `make deploy-local` (or stack already up)
2. `make seed-demo` for demo CUSTOMER/ADMIN accounts
3. Import this collection + `APTECH-4-Local.postman_environment.json`
4. Set `customerPassword` / `adminPassword` from docs/DEMO_SEED.md (placeholders in the committed environment)

**baseUrl** must be `http://localhost:8088/api/v1` (not :8080).
OpenAPI JSON is on API loopback: `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v3/api-docs` (not proxied by local nginx).

**Destructive requests** (logout, soft-disable, cancel, clear cart, checkout) are labeled — run manually; do not include them in automated Newman smoke without understanding side effects.

item.name: 00-Smoke (safe)
item.description: Read-only + login happy path. Safe for Newman when stack is seeded.

request.description: Public liveness. Expect 200 `{status:OK,service:aptech4-api}`.
Public active categories.
Public products. Saves `productId` from first item.
Requires seeded demo customer. Saves access/refresh tokens.
GET /api/v1/health
Requires `categoryId` from list. Inactive/missing → 404.
Filters: q, categoryId, minPrice, maxPrice, inStock, page, size, sort (name|price|createdAt).
Inactive product/category → 404.
Always creates CUSTOMER (201). Client cannot choose ADMIN. Change `registerEmail` each run to avoid 409.
Seeded ADMIN. Overwrites collection tokens with admin session.
Rotates refresh token; old refresh becomes invalid.
**Destructive for current refresh session.** Expect 204. Access JWT remains valid until exp. Re-login after this.

item.name: 03-Customer
item.description: Requires CUSTOMER Bearer token (Login customer first).

request.description: Requires `productId` from public product list.
Removes one line.
**Clears all cart lines** for the current customer.

body.raw:
{
  "label": "Home",
  "recipientName": "Demo Customer",
  "line1": "123 Demo Street",
  "line2": "",
  "city": "Ho Chi Minh",
  "stateRegion": "",
  "postalCode": "700000",
  "countryCode": "VN",
  "phone": "+84900000000",
  "defaultAddress": true
}

request.description: **Creates a real order** (mock payment). Cart must be non-empty. `simulateFailure` honored only when server allows client force-failure.
**Destructive.** Customer cancel allowed only for PENDING_PAYMENT. PAID orders → error. Do not run blindly after successful mock checkout.
Recipient-scoped feed (CUSTOMER or ADMIN). Newest first.

item.name: 04-Admin
item.description: Requires ADMIN Bearer token (Login admin first). Soft-disable is not hard delete.

request.description: Requires active `categoryId`. Creates a new SKU — soft-disable when done.

body.raw:
{
  "sku": "POSTMAN-TMP-{{$timestamp}}",
  "name": "Postman Temp Product",
  "description": "Created by Postman; soft-disable after tests",
  "unitPrice": 99000.0,
  "currency": "VND",
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}"
}

request.description: **Soft-disable only** (no hard DELETE). Sets active=false.
**Soft-disable.** Do not disable shared demo categories in a shared DB.
**Changes fulfillment status.** Allowed transitions per ADR-008 (PENDING_PAYMENT, PAID, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FAILED). Admin cancel does not refund/restock.
